title: Former captain introduces new PPD contact at Base 2

tellings.quote: I was working my regular job and the introduction happened by the previous captain actually showing up at my job

plain: In the early 1990s, at a large US base where several services worked together, a former captain is said to have shown up at Dan Sherman's regular job to introduce him to a new contact in a programme Sherman refers to only by the letters PPD. Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA trained him to communicate with aliens, tells Michels that the introduction was made by a Captain White, his previous captain. If true, it would mean the programme followed him from one posting to the next.
